title: Exterior look and style
summary: Feedback in this topic centers mainly on the car’s exterior appearance, with many reviewers praising its stylish, well-made look and a small amount of criticism tied to low-speed driving smoothness or control logic rather than styling itself.

positive.summary: Positive reviews consistently praise the car’s appearance as great-looking, eye-catching, stylish, and well thought out.

negative.summary: Negative reviews are limited and focus on jerky brake progression when creeping forward and dissatisfaction with the drive-versus-reverse selector direction.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are too brief to convey a clear opinion, consisting of fragmentary mentions of the car’s looks.

limitations: The sampled examples are dominated by short comments about appearance, so evidence for driving comfort or broader design details is limited.
The topic includes some negative examples about control behavior and low-speed braking that are not clearly about styling, which makes the cluster somewhat mixed in subject matter.
Many undetermined fragments are extremely short, limiting what can be concluded from them.
